messages:
maria: Heads up — small cross-repo timing question. PRs ready: sdk@github.com/redwood/sdk#842, console#1297, helm-charts#88, runtime#504. They need to land in this order because SDK bumps client API header. Can we coordinate a merge window today 4–5pm PT?

thomas: I can do 4:15–4:45. Are there any DB/migrations?

maria: No migrations. Main risk: console depends on SDK change to pass `X-Client-Feature` header. If console merges before SDK, it will fail CI. Helm needs the chart values bumped after console image tag is published.

lee: Can we split: merge SDK, run canary on staging, then console, then helm? I can watch staging canary rollout (4:20) and approve merge. @priyanka how quick is runtime compatibility check for the qkv kernel change?

priyanka: Runtime change is just flag toggle; runtime PR is safe but depends on new SDK client to use `--prefer-kernel=v2`. I'll trigger compatibility smoke tests now. Should take ~12m.

ci-bot: CI: sdk#842 — build passed; console#1297 — waiting on SDK CI; helm-charts#88 — lint passed; runtime#504 — e2e queued.

thomas: :thumbsup: ok I'll hold on console approvals until SDK is merged + ci passes. @maria can you mark SDK as 'merge when green' and ping here?

maria: Done — setting sdk#842 to MWMG and will ping here when green. Also uploading small README note for SDK changelog.

priyanka: Smoke tests done, runtime e2e queued. If SDK merges now, I can promote runtime within 20m.

lee: I can do the console merge at ~4:35 after SDK CI green and canary looks good. Helm bump I'll open a PR referencing console tag; ops can merge helm after runtime promotion.

maria: thanks all — plan: SDK merges first (MWMG), thomas hold console until green, priyanka watch runtime, lee handle console + helm PR. I'll post final freeze/unfreeze call here. :rocket:

ci-bot: CI: sdk#842 — all checks passed. Status: merged at 3642109940.
